subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Do maintainers approve exposing the final set of redacted SecretRef failure classes and cold/stale owner states in Gateway logs and doctor output without adding a protocol/status surface?
rationale: The code is deliberately defining an operator-visible diagnostics and redaction boundary for secrets; tests can verify examples but cannot choose the permanent disclosure policy.

options.title: Approve the redacted diagnostics contract
options.body: Keep the structured log and doctor output limited to the typed redacted reasons, owner metadata, state, and reload hint shown by this branch.

options.title: Narrow the exposed diagnostics
options.body: Specify which owner fields or failure classes must be omitted or generalized, then request a focused update and redaction regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Approve the redacted diagnostics contract
recommendation.body: Keep the structured log and doctor output limited to the typed redacted reasons, owner metadata, state, and reload hint shown by this branch.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged SecretRef owner-isolation boundary that this PR extends, making them the strongest feature-history routing candidate.
